title: Slider
description: A range with a filled track and the core in the thumb — the mark shows where your grip is.
usage: For values chosen by feel: volume, brightness, opacity. Always pair with the numeric value; if the exact number matters, add an Input beside it.
a11y: A native range input wrapped in its <label>, so the label names it without id/for: arrows, Page Up/Down and screen readers work as the platform defines. The visible readout repeats the value and is aria-hidden. The filled track starts at the inline start (left in LTR, right in RTL). The thumb outline uses --k-ink-3 (4.83:1 on the light page). Instances initialize once even if the script loads twice. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
